Quantum 1.25.0 was certified on 2026-08-31. It pins **nucleus v1.22.0**, **quark v1.8.0** and **orbit v1.8.14**, with 6 sibling modules.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.24.0: nucleus goes from v1.21.0 to v1.22.0 (minor), quark goes from v1.7.1 to v1.8.0 (minor) and orbit goes from v1.8.13 to v1.8.14 (patch). 5 sibling modules change version.
